official_name: Generative Adversarial Networks and Image Synthesis
official_description: This cluster of papers focuses on the application of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) in image processing, including image synthesis, style transfer, representation learning, and unsupervised learning. The papers cover various techniques such as image inpainting, texture synthesis, and conditional generative models using deep learning and neural networks.
